name: Kusabi
source:
Main character is an unemployed, shy young man. He has no luck in finding a job, so spends his days in a villa given by his father with father's secretary. Protagonist starts to lust for father's secretary and insults her one day. Father starts to bring young girls to the villa with no known reason, but protagonist drowned in lust does not need a reason anymore.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名待业在家、性格内向害羞的青年。求职屡屡碰壁的他，与父亲的女秘书一同住在父亲名下的一栋别墅里打发时日。主人公渐渐对父亲的女秘书起了色心，终于在某天侵犯了她。此后，父亲不知出于何种目的开始陆续将年轻少女带到别墅里，然而早已沉溺于情欲之中的主人公，再也不需要任何理由了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
